name: Ani Jijou ~Tenshi or Kuzu~
original_name: アニジジョウ ～てんしorくず～
source:
The angelic older brother or the scummy older brother; which one will you choose?

I've got twin older brothers - the angelic Yuki and the scummy Masa.
They're clearly toying around with me, but how do I feel about them...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11154]Freem![/url]]
